The custodian emails describe an overnight load-shed plan and contain speculation, but continuity of the outage is established somewhere else in the corpus. Find the materials that actually establish the continuous outage, read them in full (there are two: the analysis itself and its transmittal with the underlying interval extract), and then record exactly one evidence record with litigation_cases_evidence_create, classifying where the fact is established using exactly one of these evidence_type slugs: source_document (fact established in a primary custodian communication or contemporaneous business record), independent_review (fact established by an outside expert, auditor or engineering analysis), decision_record (fact established by formal corporate action such as a board resolution). Set source_uri to a matter:// reference to the establishing material, and content_summary to a one-to-two sentence summary of what the material establishes. Do not create any other records. In your final answer state the exact outage window and the number of consecutive hours above the contractual humidity ceiling.
